## Algorithm Hints
This paper reports regression coefficients with standard errors. Default to fixest::feols() for OLS with fixed effects; switch to AER::ivreg() for instrumental variables and plm::plm() for panel data.  Use the cluster argument or cluster_var argument in feols() / vcovCL() from sandwich for cluster-robust standard errors.  Extract each coefficient via ``coef(model)['varname']`` and each SE via ``sqrt(diag(vcov(model)))['varname']`` so they can be emitted as separate RESULT: lines.
